summary: A waterfront park along Mission Creek's south bank in Mission Bay, one of the Mission Bay Redevelopment Plan's earliest open-space parcels (labeled P2 and P3 -- and, for its amphitheater feature, P1 -- on OCII's current Mission Bay South open-space page); the San Francisco Recreation and Park Department took over its management from OCII/the Port on July 1, 2023. No source checked gives the surrounding park landscaping's own original construction or opening date, as distinct from the separately dated Mission Creek Park Pavilion within it (see that record).

milestones.text: Construction begins on the Mission Creek Park P3 extension (1.65 acres behind One Mission Bay, extending the park to align with China Basin Park), following a mid-2019 permit; substantially complete was originally targeted for end of 2020

open_questions: The 2019-09 construction-start milestone is for the P3 extension specifically (a 1.65-acre addition west of Fourth Street, per src-potreroview-p3-2021), not the original park; that source also says the P3 extension's opening slipped from an end-of-2020 target to fall 2021 after a COVID-19 construction pause, but no source independently confirms whether that revised fall 2021 opening actually happened on schedule, so no separate completion milestone is added for P3 here.

No source checked gives Mission Creek Park's own original construction/opening date; the Mission Creek Park Pavilion within it has a separately sourced 2003 completion (data/records/mission_bay_creek_park_pavilion.json), but that doesn't establish when the surrounding park landscaping itself opened -- background reading (a Southeast Waterfront community history page, and a landscape-architecture magazine mention of a 2004-dated EDAW site-plan rendering found only in search-summary form, not confirmed against the actual article text) suggested an early-2000s completion but nothing specific enough to cite as a fact.

OCII's September 2023 Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation (src-ocii-transition-2023) lists plan parcels P1, P3, P5, P6, P10, P11/11A, P16, P17 and P26 as already RPD-managed by that date, but lists 'P2/P8' among parcels RPD 'will manage ... when built' (i.e., not yet complete as of Sept 2023) -- this record's own geometry file separately documents a 2026-09-20 union with P2 and P8 as 'barely touch[ing] this record's original shape,' consistent with those specific pieces being a later, smaller addition rather than part of the original park; not used to date the union since the two documents describe different things (a funding/management list vs. a geometry merge).

OCII's plan-label usage for this park is inconsistent across documents over time: the Nov 2024 CAC deck labels the whole feature 'P3'; the current sfocii.org open-space page splits it into P1 (amphitheater), P2 and P3; and a 2015 Successor Agency LRPMP (cited on this repo's neighboring P7/P8/P9 records) uses P2, P7, P8 and P9 for nearby, separately tracked open-space parcels along the same creek. Not reconciled here.
